products.text:
Type: six-globe flush mount ceiling lamp
Use: general ceiling light; living room, dining room, bedroom, home office
Style: mid-century modern, modern, contemporary
Materials: opal white glass globes, matte black metal frame
Colors: white, matte black
Shape: six round globes on short angled arms radiating from a central hub, short stem to round canopy, wide and low, close to the ceiling, medium visual weight
Feel: soft, graphic, playful
Goes with: white walls, black accents, walnut wood; mid-century or modern rooms

Type: black dome pendant lamp
Use: light over a dining table; dining room, kitchen, home office
Style: industrial, retro, mid-century modern
Materials: matte black metal shade, polished chrome band and fitter, frosted diffuser
Colors: matte black, chrome silver, white
Shape: wide domed shade with chrome rim band and side screws, flat diffuser underneath, hangs on thin cord, medium size
Feel: bold, crisp, nostalgic
Goes with: dark wood, white walls, chrome accents; industrial or modern dining rooms

Type: black cone pendant lamp
Use: accent or task light from the ceiling; dining room, living room, home office
Style: mid-century modern, retro, modern
Materials: matte black metal, brushed nickel collar
Colors: matte black, silver
Shape: tilted flared cone shade with short rear cone and nickel ring, hangs on a straight rigid downrod from round canopy, slim and compact
Feel: graphic, sleek, quirky
Goes with: walnut wood, white walls, black and nickel accents; mid-century rooms

Type: woven willow globe pendant
Use: ambient ceiling light; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, coastal, rustic
Materials: woven natural willow, white cloth cord
Colors: light natural beige, white
Shape: large round globe shade with dense woven bands alternating with open slatted bands, hangs on cord, sizable but airy
Feel: warm, relaxed, natural
Goes with: light wood, linen, white walls, plants; bohemian or coastal rooms

Shape: small rounded globe shade open at bottom, short nickel fitter, hangs on fabric cord, compact

Goes with: grey tones, black metal, light wood; industrial or minimalist rooms

Use: light over a dining table; dining room, kitchen, home office
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, modern

Colors: matte light grey, white
Shape: wide cone shade topped by a slim cylindrical neck, hangs on white cord, clean lines, medium size

Goes with: light wood, white walls, pastel accents; Scandinavian rooms

Type: small grey globe pendant
Use: accent light over a table or island; dining room, kitchen, home office
Style: industrial, modern, minimalist
Materials: poly faux concrete shade, brushed nickel canopy, black cord

Type: rattan globe pendant lamp
